svg.title: Depth against width
svg.desc: Left: a potential with a narrow well of curvature 25 that is 0.3 deeper and a wide well of curvature 1. Right: the Gibbs probability of the narrow well against D. Counting depth only, it would keep a majority at every temperature; exactly (solid) and by the free-energy rule (dashed orange) it drops below one half near D = 0.19 and towards 1/6 as D grows.
svg.text: A deep narrow well and a shallow wide one
Who wins: depth at low D, width at high D
orange dashed: free energy U + (D/2) log h
